# Tests and demos {#sec-tests-demos}

This page describes how the automated tests and the demo scripts are run.

## Running the tests {.unnumbered}

```bash
make test
```

The command runs `pytest` over the `tests/` directory. All the tests must pass
before a module is considered finished.

A single test file can also be run.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_translator.py -v
```

The tests are described in detail on the
[Tests](../development/tests.qmd) page.

## Running the linters {.unnumbered}

```bash
make lint
```

Two tools are run.

- `flake8` checks the PEP 8 style, with a maximum line length of 88 characters.
- `pydocstyle` checks that the docstrings follow PEP 257.

## Running a demo {.unnumbered}

Each pipeline stage has a small script that prints a readable result.

```bash
make demo M=transpiler
make demo M=translator
make demo M=simulator
make demo M=vectorizer
make demo M=metrics
make demo M=compile
make demo M=adder
```

The `M` variable is required. The command runs
`scripts/demo_<module>.py` with the virtual environment.

The `demo_compile` script writes two files, `out/bell.json` and
`out/ghz3.json`. The `demo_adder` script writes the adder files. The `out`
directory is ignored by Git. These files can be opened with the
[3D viewer](../frontend/viewer.qmd).

## Viewing the result {.unnumbered}

The JSON that is produced can be inspected by hand, or with the viewer.

```bash
make demo M=compile
# then open frontend/viewer.html and drag out/bell.json onto the page
```

The viewer can also be served over HTTP, so that the last generated file is
loaded automatically.

```bash
python -m http.server 8000
# then open http://localhost:8000/frontend/viewer3d.html
```
